prompt: Create a cinematic sci-fi interior showing a single large cylindrical containment pod centered in a dark industrial laboratory corridor. The room is symmetrical, wide 16:9 composition, with dark concrete wall panels, glossy wet-looking metal floor, ceiling shadows, and cool white strip lights running along the upper side walls and low baseboards. Include one visible wall marking: a large gray number “7” on the right rear wall. Add three narrow cable or rail tracks leading from the foreground floor directly into the base of the pod. Use moody high-contrast lighting, volumetric haze, realistic textures, subtle reflections, no people, no creatures, no extra text, no watermark. The atmosphere should feel like a secret underground cryogenic facility or experimental containment chamber, photorealistic, cinematic, detailed, dark teal-gray shadows contrasted with warm orange light inside the pod.
